title: Tuxumdonida 300 million tuxum topilgan baliq qaysi?
hook: Bu baliqning tuxumdonida 300 million tuxum sanalgan.

scenes.text: Bir baliq urg'ochisining tuxumdonida 300 milliongacha tuxum sanalgan.
Bu baliqlar orasida qayd etilgan eng katta ko'rsatkichlardan biri.
Baliqning o'zi ham ulkan. Kattalari bir tonnagacha yetishi mumkin.
Uning dumi deyarli yo'q. Tanasi yassi va yumaloq, xuddi suzayotgan disk.
Bu oy baligi, okean oy baligining lotincha nomi Mola mola. U ko'pincha suv yuzasida yonboshlab quyoshda isinadi.

description:
Oy baligining (Mola mola) bir urg'ochisi tuxumdonidan 300 million tuxum sanalgan, bu baliqlar orasida qayd etilgan eng katta ko'rsatkichlardan biri. Bu 1920-yillardagi bitta namunaga tegishli, shuning uchun baliq bir martada shuncha tuxum qo'yishi aniq emas. Ba'zi olimlar o'sha namuna boshqa oy baligi turi bo'lishi mumkin, deb hisoblaydi. Kattalari odatda 1000 kilogrammgacha keladi va suv yuzasida yonboshlab quyoshda isinishi bilan tanilgan.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-checked 2026-11-23 (web-search summaries; pages did not open). MISLEADING fixed: the 300 million figure is an egg count from the ovaries of one 1.5 m female examined in the 1920s (Guinness, FishBase), not eggs 'laid at once'; the specimen may have been Mola alexandrini rather than Mola mola; 'eng katta' softened to 'eng katta ko'rsatkichlardan biri'. Title, hook, scenes 1-2, 5 and description reworded. Adult weight 247-1000 kg and the clavus (truncated tail) are consistent with Wikipedia/Britannica. https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/69443-most-fertile-fish ; https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/70711-most-eggs-produced-by-a-fish-in-a-single-spawning ; https://www.fishbase.se/summary/1732 ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ocean_sunfish ; https://www.britannica.com/animal/mola
